title: Design System: Music Tech Studio — Interactive Resources

display.purpose: Hero and page titles; Fraunces, one italic word allowed for emphasis.

title.purpose: Card and subsection titles; Fraunces 500 italic.

lede.purpose: Standfirst / intro paragraph beneath a headline; Fraunces italic.

label.purpose: Section markers, field labels, table headers; Geist 600, uppercase, 0.14em tracking.

mono.purpose: Data readouts (Hz, ms, BPM), shortcuts, numerical positions; Geist Mono, sparingly.

shadows.name: light
shadows.purpose: Default raised surface — hovers, popovers, small panels. Paper-on-paper, never floating.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Standard content card. A faint contact line plus a soft ambient spread; if it looks dark, it is wrong.

motion.name: ease-smooth
motion.purpose: Default easing for almost everything — transitions, entrances, hovers.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Decorative entrances that need a softer landing.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Slight overshoot for things that pop in (badges, counters). Use sparingly — this brand prefers stillness.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Symmetric moves where in and out should mirror.

motion.name: entrance-focus-in
motion.purpose: The house entrance. Content focuses into place; never a plain fade or a flick-on.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Tactile press on every interactive element — a firm press, not a collapse.

motion.name: reveal-height
motion.purpose: Expand/collapse to real content height. Never a max-height hack.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action. Field background, cream text, pill shape; deepens and lifts on hover, presses on click. Never shadowed, never gradient.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #3A4A35; color: #F2EBE0; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.8rem 1.4rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2D3A2A; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3A4A35; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary / cancel action. Transparent with a 1px Field border and Field text; subtle Field tint on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #3A4A35; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; border: 1px solid #3A4A35; border-radius: 999px; padding: calc(0.8rem - 1px) calc(1.4rem - 1px); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(58,74,53,0.08); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3A4A35; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Paper card on the cream ground. 16px radius, a single 1px warm line, paper-on-paper shadow, optional 3px accent top stripe for category coding.
components.html:
1.9 Dynamic Processing

Compression basics

Threshold, ratio, attack, release — the four controls that shape every compressor.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #F8F2E8; color: #1F2A1C; border: 1px solid #D4C9B4; border-top: 3px solid #3A4A35; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(43,36,24,0.04), 0 18px 40px -24px rgba(43,36,24,0.22); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-eyebrow { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.6875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #6B6F5C; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; font-style: italic; font-size: 1.375rem; margin: 6px 0 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #1F2A1C; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Paper background lifted from the page, 1px warm line, 12px radius. On focus the border becomes Field with a soft Field-at-18% ring. Placeholder is muted italic Fraunces.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #F8F2E8; color: #1F2A1C; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; border: 1px solid #D4C9B4; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B6F5C; font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #3A4A35; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(58,74,53,0.18); }

components.name: Tag Badge
components.description: Pill tag with a subtle tinted background (mustard ~14%) and text in the deepened accent. No border for tags; a 1px line only for filter chips.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; background: rgba(201,159,68,0.14); color: #9B7530; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75rem; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 10px; }

narrative.overview: This is what a serious independent textbook publisher would look like if it had a software studio. Warm earthen colour, editorial typography in a real serif, and the quiet confidence of something that has been thought about for longer than a sprint. It is a learning instrument first: a student should trust it the way they trust a well-made tool. The surface is never flat and never cold — a warm cream ground carries a faint paper noise and two off-page radial washes, so the page feels lit from somewhere without ever resorting to a glow or a gradient on a component. Depth is paper-on-paper: a hairline warm line and a soft, low-opacity shadow, never a UI element floating above a synthwave horizon. It explicitly rejects generic AI-template / neobrutalist work and childish edtech; the register is credibly A-Level and credibly editorial, not SaaS.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream ground, layered (noise + radial washes), never flat or pure-white or plain-dark.
One accent per surface, drawn from a strict three-tier hierarchy.
Editorial serif display (Fraunces) over a clean sans body (Geist).
Paper-on-paper depth: a 1px warm line plus a faint layered shadow, never a floating drop shadow.
Motion that focuses in rather than flicks on, and that always honours reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: A surface uses exactly one accent. A button is Field, OR Sienna, OR Mustard — never a gradient between them. Gradients are reserved for atmospheric backgrounds, never components.

rules.name: The Hierarchy-Never-Reverses Rule
rules.body: Field is the brand, Sienna is the data, Mustard is the texture. The tiers do not swap roles.

rules.name: The Fraunces-Carries-It Rule
rules.body: Headings are always Fraunces; body is always Geist. Strong is Geist 600 — never 700 black against the cream.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-For-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is reserved for data readouts, shortcuts, and numerical positions. Never headlines or body.

rules.name: The Paper-On-Paper Rule
rules.body: Depth is a faint contact line plus a soft ambient spread at very low opacity. If a shadow looks dark, it is wrong. Never Material elevation, never glow shadows, never a drop shadow under a button.

dos: Do default to Field, and use exactly one accent per surface (Field > Sienna > Mustard) — never a gradient between accents.
Do keep the background a warm cream (#F2EBE0), layered with subtle noise and two off-page radial washes — never flat, never pure-white, never plain-dark.
Do set display type in Fraunces and body in Geist; reserve Geist Mono for data readouts (Hz, ms, BPM).
Do convey depth with a 1px warm Line (#D4C9B4) plus a faint layered shadow (paper-on-paper).
Do make entrances focus in (opacity + 6px rise + 2px blur clear, ~300ms on --ease-smooth) and give every interactive element a press (scale(0.97)).
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion (already enforced) and favour transform/opacity on long lists and large surfaces.
donts: Don't use the browser default ease / ease-in-out, or the Material curve cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) — use the house easing tokens. The default curve is the clearest 'an LLM built this' tell.
Don't put a drop shadow under a button, use Material elevation-tier shadows, or glow-coloured shadows.
Don't use indigo, purple, or violet anywhere; no indigo→purple gradients; no gradient text on headings.
Don't use glassmorphism (frosted, blurred overlays) in the product UI (learn / revise / exam / topic / teacher). Glass is permitted only on brand-register marketing/home surfaces.
Don't use plain-dark backgrounds (#0a0a14, pure #000) or flat single-colour surfaces.
Don't use left-border colour stripes as decoration, or italicised serif 'highlight' words mid-sentence.
Don't put Lucide icons on visible surfaces (nav, CTAs, hero) — use Phosphor or hand-drawn there; keep Lucide for invisible utility/admin only.

Don't ship the generic AI-template / neobrutalism look (harsh borders, clashing brights, sticker shadows, default fonts) or childish edtech (cartoon mascots, primary-colour blocks, gamified-badge clutter).
Don't write asyndetic tricolon CTAs ('Fast. Simple. Powerful.') or stock CTA verbs ('Get started', 'Learn more', 'Discover').
